job.title: Engineering Manager, Maps & Search - US (Remote)
job.description: Lead and grow a hands-on Maps & Search engineering team owning home search across web and mobile. Set technical direction, contribute to code, and scale a high-throughput search platform (~1B monthly requests). Integrate AI/LLMs into discovery and ranking, and drive delivery from roadmap through incidents and production operations.
responsibilities: Lead and grow the Maps & Search team
Own hiring, onboarding, coaching, 1:1s, direct feedback, and career development
Contribute directly to code and design reviews, architecture, debugging
Drive the architecture, relevance, latency, and reliability of a real estate search system
Deliver a world-class home search experience across web and mobile
Bring LLMs and intelligent ranking into search and user workflows
Define and translate user needs and business goals into a clear technical plan

positioning: Prioritize bullets showing ownership, reliability, and cross-functional delivery impact.
project_suggestions: Highlight projects touching React, Microservices, Search experience with relevance
gap_analysis: Add quantified outcomes (latency, uptime, delivery speed, or cost savings) where possible.
